Class SetupController

java.lang.Object
com.controller.SetupController
public class SetupController extends Object
Manages the creation, loading, and validation of budget cycles for the Masroofy application. Handles persisting cycle data to a file and provides methods to initialize and reset budget cycles.

    • startNewCycle

      public BudgetCycle startNewCycle(double allowance, LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Creates a new budget cycle with the given parameters, initializes it, saves it to file, and returns it.
      Parameters:
      allowance - the total spending allowance for the cycle
      start - the start date of the cycle
      end - the end date of the cycle
      Returns:
      the newly created and saved BudgetCycle

    • resetCycle

      public void resetCycle(BudgetCycle cycle)
      Resets an existing budget cycle to its initial state and saves the updated cycle. Does nothing if the provided cycle is null.
      Parameters:
      cycle - the BudgetCycle to reset

    • isPositive

      public boolean isPositive(double allowance)
      Checks whether the given allowance amount is a positive value.
      Parameters:
      allowance - the allowance amount to validate
      Returns:
      true if the allowance is greater than zero, false otherwise

    • isValidate

      public boolean isValidate(double allowance, LocalDate start, LocalDate end)
      Validates the budget cycle input parameters. Ensures the allowance is positive, the dates are non-null, and the end date is strictly after the start date.
      Parameters:
      allowance - the total allowance amount
      start - the proposed start date
      end - the proposed end date
      Returns:
      true if all inputs are valid, false otherwise

      public BudgetCycle getCurrentCycle()

    • getSavedCycle

      public BudgetCycle getSavedCycle()
